# Panda Lab - Salk Institute for Biological Studies

> Panda Lab conducts cutting-edge research on circadian rhythms, sleep, and metabolic health, exploring how biological timing regulates human wellness and disease prevention.

Led by Satchin Panda at the Salk Institute for Biological Studies in San Diego, the lab investigates the molecular mechanisms of circadian biology and develops practical interventions like time-restricted feeding to improve metabolic health and prevent chronic diseases. The research bridges fundamental circadian science with translational applications in sleep medicine, cancer prevention, and metabolic disease treatment.
